_about: Drafts for describe_gui.py, written by Claude (/describe) after looking at each photo. pictured = the plain 'Pictured:' sentence; story_fix = a suggested typo fix to the story line (only applied if you click Apply); notes = shown in the window.

bedtime-routine-original-art.pictured: A tentacle-faced creature pulling a white bunny-ear hood over its head, in teal and rust tones.
bedtime-routine-original-art.story_fix: Sometimes you just need to get some rest, call it a night.
bedtime-routine-original-art.notes: Story looks like it's missing a word: "you just to get". Need, or want?

eldritch-beacon-original-art.pictured: A man rowing a small boat toward a lit lighthouse on a dark island, under swirling blue and orange skies.

dcc-original-art.pictured: A muscular man in heart-print boxers and spiked knee pads leaping alongside a snarling grey cat, against red splatter on white.
dcc-original-art.notes: Fan art (Dungeon Crawler Carl): kept off Etsy. Mixed media on what surface?

headless-original-art.pictured: A headless rider in white armour holding up a helmet, on a horned, shaggy beast, in front of a huge red sun.
headless-original-art.notes: Fan art (Star Wars): keep off Etsy. Mixed media on what surface?

beach-pals-original-art.pictured: Goofy melting ice-cream monsters riding a red and white camper van through the surf on a sunny beach.
beach-pals-original-art.notes: The van shows a VW logo: fine on your site, a small risk on Etsy.

the-beacon-journal.pictured: Seven hand-drawn journal pages of lighthouse sketches, floor plans and notes, stained with red, mounted in an ornate gold frame.
the-beacon-journal.notes: Is 26 × 38″ the size with the frame?

station-beach-triptych.pictured: Three panels of a busy beach: a woman in a green dress holds a sword behind her back while a giant sand monster rises on each side.
station-beach-triptych.notes: Sizes are listed left to right (12 × 16, 24 × 16, 12 × 16). Framing and year still needed.

leviathan-s-calling-original-art.pictured: An octopus-faced creature in a red fez and dark jacket plays a red electric guitar beside a red drum kit, surrounded by giant green tentacles.
leviathan-s-calling-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The figure looks like Lovecraft's Cthulhu, which is public domain. I left the name out anyway, so add it if you want it.

doppelbock-original-art.pictured: Two white and brown goats with curved horns, one leaping through the air above the other lying among red flowers, against a blue sky.
doppelbock-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo.

self-portrait-2026.pictured: A bearded, grey-haired man in red glasses shouting upward, with a carved fist punching out of the canvas, among red, navy and black paint splatters.
self-portrait-2026.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. No typos found. You could write '3d' as '3D' if you like, but I left it as is.

starlight-original-art.pictured: An astronaut floats through pink, purple and navy space, reaching one gloved hand toward the viewer, with a star reflected in the helmet visor.
starlight-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. Story line has no typos. 'Reach out and touch someone' was an old Bell/AT&T phone advert slogan, if that matters for the listing.

fall-fair-original-art.pictured: A giant blue rabbit with bulging eyes peers down beside a Ferris wheel and fair tents while small figures walk below, in blue, green and orange.
fall-fair-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. I read the creature as a rabbit because of the long upright ears and buck teeth; check that's what you meant.

the-watch-original-art.pictured: A man in a pointed-eared mask and long cape embraces a woman in a cat-eared hood, painted in dark greens against yellow-ochre and white.
the-watch-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The two figures are recognisably Batman and Catwoman, so I described their costumes and left out the character names.

the-signal-original-art.pictured: A woman in a black cat-eared suit stands on a rooftop in the rain, watching a yellow bat-shaped light over blue-grey skyscrapers.
the-signal-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The woman looks like Catwoman and the light in the sky looks like the Bat-Signal. I described both without naming them.

the-mask-original-art.pictured: A woman with closed eyes and running eye makeup pulls a blue mask with pointed ears down her face, in purple and black on red.
the-mask-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The blue mask with pointed ears and yellow eye slits may remind people of a well-known superhero cowl. I didn't name it.

cat-alley-original-art.pictured: A woman in a black catsuit with cat ears and a spiked bat walks down a city alley among black cats, in blue-grey and yellow-green.
cat-alley-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The cat-eared figure in a black suit may be read as Catwoman; I described her generically and didn't name her.

krampus-in-glass-original-art.pictured: A horned woman with a skull face, red lips, see-through arm bones and a bony tail, wearing a white blouse and green dress on turquoise.
krampus-in-glass-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The skin looks see-through, showing the skull, arm bones and tail bones underneath, so I described it as see-through.

krampus-in-metal-original-art.pictured: A blue-skinned horned woman in profile with pointed ears, a hoop earring and a tail, wearing rust-red metal armour, against purple and turquoise paint splashes.
krampus-in-metal-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The figure looks like a female demon with ram horns and a tail, so I didn't call her Krampus in the sentence. Check that the title still fits how you want her described.

krampus-in-fallout-original-art.pictured: A woman with curled ram horns, pointed ears and dark hair rests her face in her hands, painted in green, yellow and blue.
krampus-in-fallout-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The figure is a horned woman, not the usual hairy Krampus. Nothing in the painting points to the Fallout game. I described what's visible and left both names out.

krampus-in-air-original-art.pictured: A smiling horned woman with pointed ears and short spiky dark hair, in a puff-sleeved dress, reaching among floating bubbles, painted in blues and white.
krampus-in-air-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The figure looks like a young woman with goat horns, not a traditional hairy Krampus, so I didn't call her Krampus in the sentence. Her red lips are the only colour that isn't blue.

krampus-in-water-original-art.pictured: A pale woman with curling ram horns and dark shoulder-length hair holds her clasped hands to her lips, painted in blue with yellow speckles.
krampus-in-water-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The title says 'in water', but I couldn't see any water in the picture, only dripping blue paint around her, so I left water out.

krampus-on-fire-original-art.pictured: A woman with large curled ram horns rests her chin on her clasped hands, wrapped in red, orange and yellow watercolour splashes like flames.
krampus-on-fire-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The figure looks like a young woman with ram horns, not the usual hairy Krampus. I described what's painted, so check the title still fits.

found-original-art.pictured: A watercolour of a red-haired woman with her eyes closed, in a dark purple top, surrounded by green and red goblin-like creatures and splashes of pink.
found-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo.

candy-corn-original-art.pictured: A giant orange-yellow skull-faced monster with candy corn teeth grabs a small cloaked figure whose head bursts into red spray, against dark blue clouds.
candy-corn-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. No typos to fix. "a baby after they've shoved their faces" mixes singular and plural, but that's grammar, not a typo, so I left it. The small round lumps along the bottom are unclear, so I left them out.

trickster-original-art.pictured: A pumpkin-headed skeleton in a red sash holds a long staff among other armed pumpkin-headed skeletons and a giant jack-o'-lantern, in reds and blues.
trickster-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The giant jack-o'-lantern in the lower right looks like it might also be a skull. I called it a jack-o'-lantern.

worship-original-art.pictured: A crowned skeleton in red robes sits on a throne raising one hand, flanked by two red-hooded figures, before glowing yellow light and purple-red walls.
worship-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. Throne is implied by the seated pose rather than clearly drawn.

scarecrow-original-art.pictured: A tall, ragged scarecrow stands in dry brush while a small child holds a flame to its base, under an orange and red sky.
scarecrow-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The child seems to be holding a lit stick or match to the scarecrow's base, but the small flame is a bit hard to make out.

fugue-state-original-art.pictured: A man in a long coat and tie holds a giant syringe and a dripping blonde head among bloodied figures in green, blue and red.
fugue-state-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The giant syringe and green glow may be a nod to Herbert West from the film Re-Animator, so I described him in general terms. I read the blonde shape in his left hand as a severed head held by the hair; please check that.

hello-original-art.pictured: A close-up of a bald, pointy-eared face with huge round dark eyes and an open mouth of small teeth, in dark browns on black.
hello-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The bald head and pointed ears may remind people of Nosferatu, though the teeth are small rows, not fangs, so I didn't name him.

the-wave-original-art.pictured: A woman in a dress raises an arm on a dark hill toward a lighthouse between giant waves and wings, in teal and navy.
the-wave-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. There are large dark wings behind the lighthouse, possibly a dragon or similar creature. I just called them "wings", so change that if you meant something specific.

outreach-original-art.pictured: A purple lighthouse with a red lantern top and arms reaches down through swirling purple waves to grab a hand, under a yellow sky.
outreach-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. I read the lower-right shape as a second hand reaching up to be grabbed and the swirls as sea spray or waves, but they could be mist or cloud.

darklegs-original-art.pictured: A figure in a blue coat and top hat, holding a hoop, faces a white-and-red lighthouse standing on long black spider legs over pink ground.
darklegs-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. I wasn't sure about the ring at the figure's feet. It could be a hoop they're holding, or a shadow or ripple on the ground.

underneath-original-art.pictured: A white and red lighthouse on grey rocks above blue water, with a fanged, red-eyed creature crouched in the red and grey rocks underneath.
underneath-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The lighthouse looks a bit like Peggy's Cove, but I didn't name it in case that's not what you meant.

pied-piper.pictured: A kilted bagpiper stands on a pier while clawed, long-headed creatures climb a leaning lighthouse above crashing waves, in blue and yellow-green.
pied-piper.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The creatures look a lot like the Xenomorphs from the Alien films, so I described them without naming them. The piper may be in a long coat with a kilt, which is hard to tell in the rain.

chummiest-original-art.pictured: A bearded man in a cap and red glasses holds a mug beside a shark in grey-blue sea, with flames, smoke and red streaks behind.
chummiest-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The cap seems to say something like 'W... BEER' but I can't read all of it. I left out a few small details: a second shark fin, a half-sunk barrel or tank in the front, and what looks like a hand in the water at bottom left.

chummier.pictured: Two men crouch in a small boat inside a curling grey-purple wave as red-eyed teal sharks circle them through streaks of red blood.
chummier.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The dark-haired man with the eyepatch might be meant as a known film character (Snake Plissken?), so I didn't name him. The other man has long white hair and red glasses.

chums-original-art.pictured: Two bearded men in hoodies sit in a small boat under a full moon as sharks and octopus tentacles rise from teal and red water.
chums-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The boat could be a canoe or a small skiff, so I called it a small boat. The men hold cans, but I left that out to stay under 25 words.

a-real-fun-gal-original-art.pictured: A bald woman with horns and closed eyes, blood running from a wound on her forehead, in a black top against lavender paint drips.
a-real-fun-gal-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo.

dent-original-art.pictured: A man in a navy-and-white suit, half his face scarred red, strides forward holding out a coin against an orange and olive splattered background.
dent-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. This looks like a well-known comic-book villain (the name 'Dent' points that way too), so I only described what's visible. 'Gotta' is casual speech, not a typo, so the story line is unchanged.

rob-original-art.pictured: A young masked hero in a red top, yellow cape and green gloves leaps forward gripping a rope, against grey, purple and green washes.
rob-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. This is the DC character Robin (red 'R' chest logo); I left out the name and logo, so check if that matters for the listing.

cats-original-art.pictured: A woman in a black cat-eared mask and catsuit with clawed gloves crawls toward the viewer, two cats behind her, against pale pink and red-splattered paper.
cats-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The figure looks like Catwoman, so I described her as a woman in a cat-eared mask and catsuit instead of naming her.

batlady-original-art.pictured: A woman in a dark blue pointed-ear cowl and red bat emblem lunges forward, red hair flaring, over red and pink paint splatters.
batlady-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The figure is clearly recognisable as DC's Batwoman, and the chest emblem is a bat logo. Neither is named, but the product title 'BatLady' points to it, so check for trademark issues before listing on Etsy.

harles-original-art.pictured: A woman with blonde pigtails streaked pink and blue, a red top, denim shorts and spiked red gloves walks toward you gripping a bat, on a splattered rust-red background.
harles-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The character is clearly Harley Quinn, so I left the name out. The bat in her left hand is clear, but her right hand is cut off at the bottom edge, so I can't tell if she's holding a second bat (which would fit the story line).

jokes-original-art.pictured: A grinning man with green hair and white clown makeup, in a maroon suit and mustard waistcoat, reaching both orange-gloved hands toward the viewer against pink-red splatters.
jokes-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. This is clearly the Joker (DC Comics), so I left the name out. The gloves look orange or tan in the photo.

bats-original-art.pictured: A masked man in a blue cowl, cape and gold belt flies straight at the viewer with both fists forward, surrounded by small bats and red and turquoise paint splatter.
bats-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. This is clearly Batman: the bat emblem on the chest and the cowl make him recognisable, so you may want to think about trademark risk before listing.

leap-original-art.pictured: A man in a grey suit, black cowl, cape and yellow belt jumps between tall dark city towers, painted in watercolour greys, browns and yellow-green.
leap-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The figure is a recognisable trademarked superhero (pointed-ear cowl, cape, yellow utility belt), so I described him without naming him.

the-controller-original-art.pictured: A one-eyed figure with bared teeth in a red buttoned coat, tied by cords to giant pale hands, against dripping blue paint.
the-controller-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The red shape at the top looks like a giant red sleeve cuff, so I left it out to keep the sentence short.

glint-original-art-krampus.pictured: A red-haired woman in a pink cloak holds a sword, facing a huge brown bear at the edge of a misty purple-grey lake.
glint-original-art-krampus.story_fix: Sometimes you need to stare into each other's eyes, deeply, and wonder where we went wrong.
glint-original-art-krampus.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. Story fix: 'each others' became 'each other's'. The red-haired woman and the big bear look like Merida and Mor'du from Pixar's Brave, so I didn't name them. Also, the image file is named 'krampus', but the painting shows a bear, so check the right photo is linked to Glint.

miss-krampus-original-art.pictured: A pale horned woman with pointed ears looks down, eyes closed, wearing a teal top and red skirt amid red paint splatters on white.
miss-krampus-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. There are red streaks running down from her closed eyes. I left them out to stay under 25 words, so add them if you want them in.

lady-krampus-original-art.pictured: A horned woman with blue and green hair and red eyes, wearing a red slip dress, looking down against blue watercolour splashes on white.
lady-krampus-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo.

handy-original-art.pictured: A red-haired woman in a white top and shorts leans among floating bug-eyed creatures and a giant purple hand, in teal, purple and rust watercolour.
handy-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. I couldn't tell for sure whether the purple shape on the left is a large clawed hand or something else; it may be holding a piece of cloth.

shocked-original-art.pictured: A red-haired woman in a green top gasps with a hand on her cheek, surrounded by animal creatures and skulls in greens, browns and purples.
shocked-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. No typos in the story line. The creatures look like rabbits, birds and animal skulls, but some are hard to tell apart, so I kept it general.

blinky-original-art.pictured: A red lighthouse with ladders, its base melting into long tentacles that curl through crashing blue and teal waves under an orange-yellow sky.
blinky-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. I read the swirling orange-green shapes at the lighthouse's base as tentacles. If they're meant to be bent waves or the tower warping, change that word.

standoff-original-art.pictured: A girl in a red skirt stands on rocky ground facing a giant grey, red and yellow robot with green tentacles beside a lighthouse.
standoff-original-art.notes: Drafted by Claude: check it against the photo. The lighthouse appears to be inside the robot's tentacles or right next to it, and I couldn't tell which, so I wrote 'beside'. The blue sky was cut to stay under 25 words.
